description: Verify that DUT does NOT emit periodic gratuitous ARPs for its claimed Link-Local address (RFC 3927 §4, SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §4 advises hosts SHOULD NOT spam periodic gratuitous ARPs for a claimed Link-Local address — the 2 Announces of the claim phase are sufficient. This case lets DUT complete its claim and a single legitimate Reply (triggered by an AIFACE-LL Request), then watches a long absence window for unsolicited periodic broadcasts.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 2 Announces → claim done. The post-claim observer fires on Listening_post_claim entry, after both Announces. ANNOUNCE_WAIT + ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL must elapse first because Announces share the gratuitous-shape filter and would otherwise false-fail the absence guard.

3. Tester → DUT: UT-query DUT_LL → snapshot it → emit AIFACE-LL ARP Request (target = DUT_LL) on the secondary interface. DUT's responder must broadcast a Reply per RFC 3927 §2.5 last MUST. The SCXML transitions to listening_no_periodic on that Reply.

4. Observation (listening_no_periodic absence window):
   • DUT must NOT emit any further gratuitous ARP for the committed Link-Local

[Pass condition]
3 Probes + 2 Announces claim + 1 broadcast Reply for the AIFACE-LL Request + no further gratuitous ARP within the absence window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_claim_observed — DUT never announced the committed LL
• Fail_only_one_announce — fewer than 2 Announces within the deadline
• Fail_no_responder_reply — DUT did not emit an ARP Reply for the AIFACE-LL Request
• Fail_reply_wrong_fields — Reply carried wrong fields or unicast Eth dst
• Fail_periodic_gratuitous_arp — DUT emitted an extra periodic gratuitous ARP for the committed LL after the claim is done

verdicts.Pass: DUT did not emit periodic gratuitous ARPs after the claim — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_claim_observed: DUT did not announce committed Link-Local address
verdicts.Fail_only_one_announce: Fewer than 2 ARP Announces within the deadline
verdicts.Fail_no_responder_reply: DUT did not emit an ARP Reply for the claim address
verdicts.Fail_reply_wrong_fields: DUT's ARP Reply carried wrong fields or unicast Ethernet destination
verdicts.Fail_periodic_gratuitous_arp: DUT emitted a periodic gratuitous ARP for its committed Link-Local
